lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately three horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in a staggered grid-like configuration.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming high-intensity nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge to darker shadow gradients on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex labyrinthine/vermiculated pattern of lines is present on the head and the region directly superior to the gill slits. A slender, low-luminance remora-like organism is visible positioned against the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
